newsitem.title: USA: AMP expects Q3 EPS in $0.45 to $0.50 range.
newsitem.headline: AMP expects Q3 EPS in $0.45 to $0.50 range.

text.p: AMP Inc said on Thursday its third quarter earnings are expected to be in the $0.45 to $0.50 range, which is below the company's previous expectations due to price erosion and a strong U.S. dollar.
Sales for the period are expected to be slightly below the second quarter's $1.37 billion, AMP said in a statement.
In last year's third quarter, the company posted sales of $1.30 billion and earnings of $0.51 a share.
AMP president and chief executive officer William Hudson presented the company's outlook at the Merrill Lynch Connector/Passive Components conference in New York.
AMP said quarterly earnings have been fairly flat the last four quarters because of the combined effects of slow sales growth, price erosion, and the strengthening of the U.S. dollar.

The company had said in a July conference call with analysts that it had expected sales and earnings similar to the second quarter, with results of $1.37 billion in sales and $0.53 a share, it it had steady results in August and improved September results.
Analysts had a consensus earnings estimate of $0.53 a share for the third quarter, according to First Call.
AMP said it continues to expect better sales and earnings in the fourth quarter based on customer and distributor input and the economic outlook in most major countries.
A pickup in our connector sales should help its margins and it expects to break even in Global Interconnect Systems in the fourth quarter, the company said.

AMP president and chief executive William Hudson commented on results and the company's outlook at the Merrill Lynch Connector/Passive Components Conference in New York. The company issued a separate statement about the forecast.
